source_semantics: Huawei GENERATED items remain unallocated until physical pickup; published unpicked assignments are tentative; destination and current work remain locked
service_promise: Every released request remains required until delivered; accepted status is irreversible and does not freeze an unpicked vehicle assignment
committed_work: physical carrying stack and pickup ownership
current visit operations preserved by this DPDP bridge
tentative_work: Unpicked work outside current visit may be reassigned or omitted from the current publication; it remains in the observable request ledger and next unallocated input
per_dispatch_validation: Every published/physical item has complete remaining service, capacity, LIFO, precedence, unique operations and locked work; all observed items occur in exactly one ledger category
completion_gate: All input requests observed and all items delivered; existing independent scorer passes before valid J
forbidden: rejection or cancellation of required requests
historical_comparability: Semantic revision, not a backwards-compatible bug fix. Legacy references and scores are not certified for this contract. New references and a versioned training protocol are required before GP training under v3.
fitness: No new fitness or training split is enabled by this descriptor
scope: Saved-epoch replay and bounded synthetic integration verification; no full reference or GP training in the resolution task
